title: GPA Calculator (Semester & Cumulative)
description: Calculate your semester GPA and cumulative GPA on a 4.0 scale. Add your courses, credits and letter grades — results update instantly.
blurb: Semester and cumulative GPA on a 4.0 scale.

title: Final Grade Calculator — What Do I Need on My Final?
description: Find out exactly what score you need on your final exam to reach the course grade you want, based on your current grade and the final's weight.
blurb: The score you need on the final to hit your target grade.

title: Weighted Grade Calculator
description: Work out your course grade from weighted categories like homework, quizzes and exams. Handles weights that don't add up to 100% yet.
blurb: Your course grade from weighted categories.

title: APA & MLA Citation Generator (Books, Articles, Websites)
description: Create APA 7th edition and MLA 9th edition citations for books, journal articles and web pages. Copy with italics intact.
blurb: APA 7 and MLA 9 citations for books, articles and websites.

title: Word Counter with Reading & Speaking Time
description: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs, and estimate reading and speaking time for essays and speeches.
blurb: Words, characters, reading and speaking time.

title: Pomodoro Study Timer
description: A free Pomodoro timer for studying: focus sessions, short breaks and long breaks, with adjustable lengths and a sound when time is up.
blurb: Focus sessions and breaks with an alarm.

title: Exam Countdown & Study Hours Planner
description: Count the days until your exam and spread your study hours across the days you have left, skipping your days off.
blurb: Days until your exam and hours to study per day.

title: Percentage Calculator
description: Three percentage calculators in one: X% of Y, X is what percent of Y, and percentage increase or decrease.
blurb: Percent of, percent change and more.
